beats.text: Running three distinct models for RLHF—Actor, Critic, and Reward—is a multi-billion parameter recipe for absolute training instability.
beats.visual_focus: Three heavy, disconnected neural network blobs pulsating and losing sync.

visual_blueprint.title: THE RLHF OVERHEAD
visual_blueprint.sub: Synchronization bottleneck between Actor, Critic, and Reward models

motif_params.title: THE RLHF OVERHEAD
motif_params.sub: Synchronization bottleneck between Actor, Critic, and Reward models

beats.text: The bottleneck? The reward model effectively creates a target that shifts as the policy updates, forcing continuous, expensive re-sampling cycles.
beats.visual_focus: A central reward model shrinking while the policy tries to follow it, causing GPU memory spikes.

visual_blueprint.title: REWARD MODEL DRIFT
visual_blueprint.sub: Policy divergence due to non-stationary feedback loops

motif_params.title: REWARD MODEL DRIFT
motif_params.sub: Policy divergence due to non-stationary feedback loops

beats.text: DPO pivots by mathematically mapping the reward function directly to the optimal policy, treating alignment as a simple classification problem.
beats.visual_focus: The three blobs merge into a single, clean transformation stream.

beats.text: By calculating the log-ratio of preference probabilities, the model directly optimizes toward chosen responses without needing an explicit reward function.
